sourceSummary: West Ham United 2026/27 current first-team audit using the club's live squad page plus current transfer evidence. El Hadji Malick Diouf, Jean-Clair Todibo, Aaron Wan-Bissaka and James Ward-Prowse are removed before publication; Morato, Joel Veltman, Ollie Scarles and Arne Engels replace them one-for-one. Current-club evidence is kept separate from the latest published valuation source where summer registrations lag.
